items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: I thought of another band that used to have two clarinets, Buddy Bolden.

ctx.x: Uh, I would think maybe the... Stay out of the rhythm section. I would think the drum. I don't know. I mean, some, you know, maybe other people might have a different opinion of that, but I think the drum. A lot of times, I mean, uh, the drum, the, uh, bass will take the place of the drum. Or the banjo will take the place of the drum, you see. And I've just gotten so that, uh, I don't know if I could really play anymore without listening to a banjo sitting alongside of it. I've played already without a banjo and…
Yeah, well, that banjo sure gives you chords and everything. Helps you along. All that. I thought of another band that used to have two clarinets, Buddy Bolden. You've seen the picture of that?
Oh. With two clarinets? I'll show it to you.
